goal: 向工作人员说清情况并改签成功

n1.speaker: 车站工作人员 Officer
n1.line: Hello, sir. How can I help you? You look a little upset.
n1.lineCn: 您好,先生。有什么能帮您的?您看起来有点着急。

grammar.name: 过去完成时的触发点
grammar.note: 本课重点:过去的过去。讲述先发生的事要用 had + 过去分词。

options.text: I missed my train. It had already left before I arrived at the station.
options.textCn: 我错过了火车。我到车站时它已经开走了。
options.feedback: 用 had already left 交代了"先走、后到"的顺序,情况清楚。
光喊单词,工作人员完全不明白发生了什么。
明明来求助却说没事,工作人员没法帮你。

n2.speaker: 车站工作人员 Officer
n2.line: Oh no! Which train was it? Had you arrived early enough to catch it?
n2.lineCn: 哦天哪!是哪趟车?你有没有提早到车站赶上它呢?

grammar.name: Had you done...? 过去完成时疑问
grammar.note: 问过去某个时间点之前是否做过某事,用 Had + 主语 + 过去分词。

options.text: It was the 8:15 express to Shanghai. I had left home at 7:00, but the bus had broken down on the way.
options.textCn: 是 8 点 15 分开往上海的快车。我 7 点就出门了,但公交车半路抛锚了。
options.feedback: 具体车次加原因,还用了两个过去完成时,条理清晰。

options.text: I forgot which train it was.
options.feedback: 说不清车次,工作人员无法帮你查询改签。

n3.speaker: 车站工作人员 Officer
n3.line: Take a deep breath. What had happened before you got here? Tell me from the beginning, please.
n3.lineCn: 深呼吸。你来这儿之前发生了什么?请从头讲起。

grammar.name: 过去完成时描述背景
grammar.note: What had happened before...? 用 had 强调事情发生在到站之前。

options.text: I had planned to catch the 8:15 train, but the taxi was stuck in a traffic jam. So I missed it.
options.textCn: 我本来打算坐 8 点 15 的车,但出租车堵在了路上,所以错过了。
options.feedback: 从"原计划"讲到"堵车",再到"错过",顺序清楚。

options.text: I do not want to talk about it. Just help me!
options.textCn: 我不想说。直接帮我就行!
options.feedback: 不说情况就改签,工作人员无从下手。

n4.speaker: 车站工作人员 Officer
n4.line: I see. Your ticket was for the 8:15 train, and the train had already departed when you arrived. Let me check the next train for you.
n4.lineCn: 明白了。你的票是 8 点 15 的车,你到的时候车已经开走了。我帮你查下一班车。

grammar.name: 过去完成时表"已发生"
grammar.note: had already departed 强调"到站时车已经开走",先发生动作用过去完成时。

options.text: Thank you so much! Had the next train already left when you looked?
options.textCn: 太感谢了!你查的时候下一班车已经开走了吗?
options.feedback: 道谢并追问时刻,把改签落实到时间上。
急着退票,但其实改签就能解决问题。

n5.speaker: 车站工作人员 Officer
n5.line: We can offer a refund, but it may cost extra. Are you sure you do not want to change your ticket instead?
n5.lineCn: 可以退票,但可能要扣手续费。你确定不改签吗?

grammar.name: instead 的用法
grammar.note: instead 表示"代替,反而",用于提出另一选择。

options.text: You are right. I should change the ticket. I have already missed enough today.
options.textCn: 你说得对,我应该改签。我今天已经错过太多车了。
options.feedback: 接受建议改签,用现在完成时调侃自己,沟通顺畅。

options.text: No, I only want my money back.
options.feedback: 固执己见,既误行程又损失手续费。

n6.speaker: 车站工作人员 Officer
n6.line: Good decision. The next train leaves at 10:00. Would you like to change to that one?
n6.lineCn: 明智的选择。下一班车 10 点出发。您要改到这一班吗?

grammar.name: Would you like to...?
grammar.note: would like to do 表礼貌请求或建议,比 want to 更委婉。

options.text: Yes, please. I had worried about being stuck here all day, but now everything is solved!
options.textCn: 好的,谢谢。我之前还担心要被困在这儿一整天,现在都解决了!
options.feedback: 同意改签,还用过去完成时回顾了之前的担心,完美收尾。
态度敷衍,但好在改签已办好。

success.speaker: 车站工作人员 Officer
success.line: All done! Here is your new ticket. Have a safe trip!
success.lineCn: 办好了!这是您的新车票。祝您旅途顺利!

fail1.speaker: 车站工作人员 Officer
fail1.line: I am sorry, but without the details I cannot help you. Please come back with your ticket.
fail1.lineCn: 抱歉,没有详细信息我没法帮您。请带着车票再来一趟。

fail2.speaker: 车站工作人员 Officer
fail2.line: As you wish. Please fill in this form for the refund at the window on the left.
fail2.lineCn: 随您吧。请在左边窗口填一下退票表格。
